plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: logo then bottle then the big 'Glow.' headline, with the CTA as the right-hand endpoint, packed into evenly spaced columns so nothing is left floating in dead space.

The product leads at the far left and sits right beside a large centered-left headline, while logo and CTA stack together in a tight sign-off block on the right, so the brand and the action are grouped.

Headline-first: 'Glow.' opens the strip at the left as the dominant word, the bottle follows as its visual proof, the CTA sits in the middle-right, and the logo closes the strip at the right edge as the brand sign-off.
